description: This file defines a React functional component called Tabs that provides accessible tabbed navigation with keyboard support and ARIA attributes. The component manages state for active tab and focus index, handles keyboard navigation, and renders tabs and their associated panels.

methods.name: selectByIndex
methods.description: Selects a tab by its index, updating active state and triggering onChange callback if provided.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation (Arrow keys, Home, End) and selection (Enter, Space). Uses useCallback for memoization.

methods.name: tabId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for tab elements based on index and idBase.

methods.name: panelId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for tab panels based on index and idBase.

ctags.name: Tabs
ctags.pattern: /^export default function Tabs({ items = [], onChange, initialKey, idBase = 'tabs' }) {$/
